messages:
elaine: Quick proposal — we need a progressive rollout for model-routing v3 that includes an A/B sample for the ranking change + staged regions + explicit fast-fail fallback. Sketch below, want thumbs by EOD.

sam: +1. need clear circuit thresholds and a kill-switch. propose p99 latency > 500ms OR 5% error_rate over 5m triggers rollback.

raj: agree. runtime can support dual-routing: 90/10 split initially, then 75/25, then 50/50. we'll add prefix cache warmup for staged tenants to avoid cold-start noise.

marta: for A/B, we need min sample N=1k successful requests per cohort to compute quality delta. Required logs: prompt_hash, model_version, tokens_in/out, latency_ms, error_code.

elaine: OK. telemetry SLOs: p99 latency, 24h quality regression on evaluation set, cost delta (<10% above baseline). Also require per-tenant opt-in flag + explicit consent for experimental routing.

sam: ops notes: make flag gradations: off, control, experiment, drain. expose per-tenant override + global percent rollout. add circuit-breaker with manual override.

raj: config draft: 
```
flag: model_routing_v3
variants:
  - control: 0.9
  - experiment: 0.1
kill_conditions:
  - p99_latency_ms: 500
  - error_rate_pct: 5
metrics: [latency_ms, error_rate_pct, quality_delta, token_cost]
```

marta: add A/B test id and sample_id to telemetry payload. rolling windows: 1h for fast signals AND cumulative 24h for stability.

opsbot (bot): deploy-job #deploy_482 scheduled: warm-canary -> traffic-shift -> monitor. CI: all checks passed.

elaine: rollback policy: auto-rollback if any kill_condition sustained for 10m AND >200 requests in that window. manual rollback if >2 tenants report degraded quality or any P1.

sam: also add region fallback: if eu-region p99 spikes, failover eu traffic to global-fallback variant (quantized model) and mark an incident. route policy: region->fallback->global.

raj: will add fallback variant built from a quantized checkpoint with lower memory and lower token cost. variant will be labeled `fallback_quant` and instrumented for drift detection.

marta: experiment analysis plan: compute uplift using bootstrap CIs, surface per-tenant deltas; flag-level alert if any tenant shows >10% negative quality AND >0.5% volume share. export CSV for PM and SEs.

elaine: action items:
- raj: implement flag + fallback variant (ETA 2d)
- sam: add kill-switch + alerting + runbook (ETA 1d)
- marta: telemetry dashboard + A/B report template (ETA 3d)
- pm: I'll coordinate customer comms and support docs

sam: noted. i'll post the emergency rollback playbook snippet to #eng-oncall and link runbook.

raj: starting PR now. tagging @marta @sam for review.

marta: thanks — will prepare the evaluation prompt set and the sampling harness.

elaine: thanks team. tagging @oncall for awareness :bell:
